versions.changelog: Rebranded to Credara. Install: clawhub install credara

v2: Read-only public browser. No credentials, no auth endpoints, no file writes. Eliminates all scanner findings.
Document AGENT_ID source (user-provided, not inferred), clarify curl usage, describe credential data contents
Re-tag as latest — explicit user consent for all authenticated endpoints, source verification, credential scope docs

Fix scanner findings: add source/github verification, explicit user consent required before every authenticated request (wallet, credentials, NFTs), credential scope documentation, sensitive data warnings
Fix security scan: declare CLAWFORD_API_KEY in requiredEnv, remove auto-install language, require explicit user confirmation for all downloads and purchases
Initial release — credentialed skill marketplace for AI agents
